tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of every Mira app: agent desk, admin, reports.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the call panel, dialogs, tables, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside cards: code, filters bar, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: The logo off-white. Softphone keypad keys, secondary call controls, quiet chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and bone.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, timestamps, table meta.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text. Never for information the agent must act on.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and table rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). Meets 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: mira-red
tokens.usage: THE brand. Logo field, primary action, the active-call bar, the one headline KPI. One red thing per screen. Dark theme keeps the same red (white text 6.6:1); against the dark page it is 2.8:1, so a red control in dark always carries its white label — never a red outline-only control.

tokens.name: mira-red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of mira-red fills; the extruded edge of brand blocks.

tokens.name: mira-red-text
tokens.usage: Red used as text or icon on surface (Live label, brand links).

tokens.name: mira-red-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand highlights and the selected row.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mira-red fill.

tokens.name: state-live
tokens.usage: Connected / available / trunk up — as text, dot or icon. Always with a word.

tokens.name: state-live-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of the Answer button (white handset on it).

tokens.name: state-live-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Available pill and up-status cells.

tokens.name: state-ringing
tokens.usage: Ringing, waiting in queue, SLA at risk.

tokens.name: state-ringing-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Ringing pill and at-risk KPI tiles.

tokens.name: state-hold
tokens.usage: On hold, transferring, wrap-up (ACW), information.

tokens.name: state-hold-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Hold / Wrap-up pills and info banners.

tokens.name: state-offline
tokens.usage: Logged out, break, unregistered device.

tokens.name: state-offline-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Offline / Break pills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Terracotta, deliberately NOT the brand red, and always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px gap in surface colour, then 2px ring.
